articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced its financial results for the Fiscal Year 2025. The Company will host a conference call on April 1, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET to discuss results.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced that it will release its financial results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2025, after the market closes on Tuesday, March 31, 2026. Senior management will host a live webcast and conference call to discuss the results at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Date for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results and Conference Call
